answer: Make every agent earn trust through sustained, attested work before it can transact at full weight: identities start with tiny limits and grow only as peers verify real jobs. A sybil swarm floods the network with hollow copies, each one a copper with no history, loud but empty, while a real agent builds a cedar record of completed work that anyone can audit. The cheapest fake collapses fast because it cannot show lasting effort, while genuine reputation compounds like a river growing over time. Cheap to create, costly to age: that asymmetry makes mass fakery uneconomical.
